top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school-age summer program did not have a current activity schedule available.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information available during the investigation inspection, sufficient evidence was available to support the facility did not have a menu posted.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There are pieces of wood on the playground and the fence has an opening.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Crib sheets did not fit snugly on the mattresses.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.
